title: Acute Abdomen in Kawasaki Disease
brief_summary: Clinical and histopathological description of three cases of Kawasaki disease with acute abdomen.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with Kawasaki disease.
* Acute abdomen requiring surgery.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with chronic gastrointestinal disease.
* Incomplete data on the charts.
